name: Venomancer: Carapace Crash summons a Spider Lord scarab (#5374)
contract: Original Carapace Crash 573063 is Magic damage, costs 250 raw Rage, uses caster-centred area targeting
and requires Beetle Form 803183. Spider Lord 704264 supplies its original 40 percent summon chance.
Scarab 560989 uses creature 999299 and original SpellDuration 29: 12000ms. A live count only at the end
of twenty casts discarded expired successes and had a documented two-percent random failure.
An ordinary untalented area cast must land and produce no Scarab. Ten independent cohorts each perform
six funded ordinary casts, preserving their GCD, hit rolls, proc probability and summon lifetime.
All six observations occur within nine seconds, before any twelve-second summon can expire; the count
must be monotonic and increase by zero or one per cast. A thirteen-second gap must clear every cohort.
The exact binomial check uses all sixty eligible casts and actual observed Scarab increments, including
successes that later expire. No explicit unit target is supplied, exercising the original area-cast
